title: Effective etale descent of fine log schemes with a compatible polarization
statement:
Let $(S,M)$ be a fine log scheme: a log scheme in the sense of [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] with etale-local charts by finitely generated integral monoids, without requiring saturation. Let $\{U_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be a jointly surjective etale covering [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with the pulled-back log structures. Thus these morphisms are strict: the source log structure is the log structure associated to the inverse image of $M$ and its structure map. For every $i$ let $X_i\to U_i$ be a fine log scheme. On $U_{ij}=U_i\times_SU_j$ [def-pc-fibre-product] suppose given log isomorphisms
$$\theta_{ij}:X_i\times_{U_i}U_{ij}\xrightarrow{\sim}X_j\times_{U_j}U_{ij}$$
over $U_{ij}$, satisfying the identity and cocycle conditions on triple fibre products. Let $L_i$ be an invertible module on the underlying scheme of $X_i$ [def-sc-invertible-module], with isomorphisms $\theta_{ij}^*L_j\simeq L_i$ satisfying the same cocycle conditions. Assume that $L_i$ is relatively ample over $U_i$: for every affine open $V\subseteq U_i$, its restriction to the inverse image of $V$ is ample in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Then there exist a fine log scheme $X\to S$, an invertible module $L$ on its underlying scheme, and isomorphisms $(X,L)\times_SU_i\simeq(X_i,L_i)$ inducing all the specified data. The resulting object with these identifications is unique up to unique compatible isomorphism. If all $X_i$ are fs, then $X$ is fs. Moreover, morphisms of fine log schemes are local on the source for the strict etale topology: for any fine log schemes $T,Z$ over $S$, any jointly surjective strict etale covering $\{T_a\to T\}$, and any family of log $S$-morphisms $T_a\to Z$ agreeing on $T_a\times_TT_b$, there is a unique log $S$-morphism $T\to Z$ inducing that family.

source.place: Tag 0D3C (lemma-descending-property-ample), together with spaces.tex Tag 02WW (theorem-presentation) and spaces-descent.tex Tag 04W8 (proposition-fpqc-descent-quasi-coherent), for effective descent with a relatively ample sheaf. Fine log structures and their morphisms descend as sheaves of monoids on the small etale site; ILO Expose VIII 3.3.8, printed pp. 107--108, invokes this descent for log charts.

proof.text: Forget log structures. Apply [lem-trf-polarized-scheme-etale-descent] to the underlying scheme and line-bundle data: both cocycles are specified, and ampleness is assumed over every affine open of $U_i$. Obtain $f:X\to S$, $L$, and compatible polarized scheme identifications with $(X_i,L_i)$.

source.place: Tag 0D3C with scheme effectivity through Tags 02WW and 04W8.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-base-change], the projections $p_i:X_i\to X$ form a jointly surjective etale cover. The fibre-product universal property [def-pc-fibre-product] identifies $X_i\times_XX_j$ with $X\times_SU_{ij}$. The given log transitions and maps to $S$ therefore satisfy [lem-trf-log-structure-fixed-scheme-enhancement]. Apply it to this fixed $f$: it gives local Noetherianity of $X$, a fine log structure, the log map to $S$, and fs charts if all the $X_i$ are fs. These strict identifications preserve the original transitions and polarization.

source.place: VI 1.1 and VIII 3.3.8; fixed-scheme log enhancement extracted from returned steps 2--5.

proof.text: For two realizations, [lem-trf-polarized-scheme-etale-descent] gives the unique compatible polarized scheme isomorphism $h:X\to X'$, over $S$, including its inverse and line-bundle comparison. The local log comparisons agree on the cover $X_i\to X$ and have underlying maps $hp_i$. Apply [lem-trf-log-morphism-fixed-map-etale-lifting] to $h$: its relative clause makes the lift over the log base, and its isomorphism clause gives the inverse log comparison. Every compatible isomorphism has this same underlying polarized scheme comparison and the same log lift by the two uniqueness clauses.

source.place: VIII 3.3.8, uniqueness of descended charts and maps; returned step 6, using uniqueness of polarized scheme descent.

proof.text: For the final assertion, [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-finer-than-etale] and [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-representable-descent] descend the compatible underlying maps $g_a:T_a\to Z$ to a unique scheme map $g:T\to Z$. The equations $zg_a=tq_a$ imply $zg=t$ by the same representable-descent uniqueness with target $S$. Strictness identifies the local source log structures with $M_T|_{T_a}$. Apply [lem-trf-log-morphism-fixed-map-etale-lifting] to the now fixed $g$ and these local log maps: its relative clause supplies a log $S$-morphism. Scheme-map uniqueness and fixed-map log-lift uniqueness prove the required uniqueness.

mathlib_searches.query: Effective etale descent for schemes equipped with compatible relatively ample invertible sheaves and fine logarithmic structures.
A scheme with an ample line bundle descends under an etale covering if the ample invertible sheaf has compatible descent data.
